title: Majority error bound
statement: Let $p\in[0,1]$, let $\varepsilon>0$ satisfy $\tfrac12+\varepsilon\le p$, and let $k$ be a positive integer. For $k$ independent Bernoulli trials with success probability $p$, the probability that at most half of the trials succeed is at most $\exp(-2\varepsilon^2k)$.
